description: Shared Capture Bundle v1 path-collision vectors. The v1 collision-key algorithm is: normalize the logical path to Unicode NFC (canonical composition), then apply full Unicode case folding. Reference implementation: unicodedata.normalize("NFC", path).casefold() (Python); String.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping then folding(options: [.caseInsensitive], locale: en_US_POSIX) (Swift). Two distinct NFC paths that produce the same key collide and must be rejected by the directory scanner, manifest validation, and archive validator/importer alike. Each vector's left and right spellings must both produce the stated collision_key.
